data.signalSource: Binance Spot original H1 BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT ZIP klines; time is UTC epoch seconds at bar open; OHLC and quote/taker-buy-quote volumes are required
data.executionSource: Binance USD-M perpetual H1 for fills, mark H1 for valuation, realized funding events only while position is open
data.missingOrInvalid: Skip signal if required bar is missing, duplicated, off-hour, has invalid OHLC or nonpositive quote volume; N5 also requires 24 contiguous valid preceding hours. Never synthesize a bar or funding event.
data.signalTimestamp: Key is the open time of the H1 spot candle that has just closed. Information becomes available at key+3600 seconds; earliest entry is next perp H1 open at key+3600 seconds.
data.futureData: Signal generation must be prefix invariant: later candles or funding cannot alter previous decisions.

sharedExecution.entry: perp H1 open at signal bar time+3600 if contiguous and executable; otherwise skip
sharedExecution.timeExit: perp H1 open at entry time+7200
sharedExecution.adverseStop: Perp trade high/low determines stop touch; if opening gap below stop, fill at the worse open. If target/time exit and stop ambiguous, stop first.
sharedExecution.funding: Only realized USD-M funding events strictly after fill and through exit according to exchange event timestamp; mark-price H1 for risk and drawdown. No forecast funding as income.
sharedExecution.riskAndCosts: Inherited from parent and root execution protocol; base fee 5 bps per side plus 2 bps slippage per side, stress 10+5 bps per side, subject to actual spread and funding. These are assumptions, not observed broker costs.

N5.name: Delayed continuation after taker-buy pressure
N5.economicMechanism: Aggressive buy flow may precede adjustment when the same hour's spot price barely moved.
N5.indicator: 2*taker_buy_quote_volume/quote_volume-1 on the completed current spot H1
N5.quoteVolumeMinimum: Median quote_volume of the 24 contiguous valid spot H1 immediately BEFORE current H1, inclusive comparison
N5.pretestChange: Initial idea used base-volume fields; BEFORE any performance was viewed, the registered N5 rule switched to the official spot taker_buy_quote_volume / quote_volume fields. This is one hypothesis, with no reversal branch or later selection between base and quote variants.

N6.name: BTC-to-altcoin lag
N6.economicMechanism: A completed BTC spot H1 jump may reach ETH or SOL with a lag.
N6.counting: Both followers and all trades together are one family; ETH wins a simultaneous qualifying tie. No BTC position, pair hedge, rotation ranking or short branch.

approval: No backtest, net profitability, low drawdown or operational approval is implied by this file.
